Let's Make a Monster!
история Speak & Smile · Спики собирает друга-монстра
тапни / стрелка →
I've got plasticine!
Squish, squish, squish —
let's make a MONSTER!
🦝 Let's make a monster!
Put on the eyes!
Two big eyes —
look, look, look!
🦝 Two big eyes!
Put on the nose!
One long nose —
wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
🦝 A long nose!
Put on the mouth!
A big wide mouth —
one, two teeth. Say cheese!
🦝 A big smile!
Put on the ears!
Two floppy ears —
flip and flop!
🦝 Two ears!
Put on the arms!
Four wiggly arms —
one, two, three, four!
🦝 Four arms!
It's ALIVE!
The monster jumps up —
tickle, tickle! Ha, ha, ha!
👾 Hello, friend!
My monster friend!
Eyes and nose, mouth and ears —
my monster is my friend!
🦝👾 Hooray!
